rejected_attempts.reason: The added Darwin ACL fixture assumed an absent extended ACL would return an empty ACL object. Native acl_get_file returned ENOENT. The fixture now recognizes this exact native absence and restores an empty native ACL; ACL denial assertion remained unchanged. Final normal and sanitizer tests passed; fixture roots are empty.

Apple ASan rejected detect_leaks=1 before executing tests. No code validation is claimed from that run. The same built executable passed with supported ASan+UBSan options and detect_leaks=0. No macOS LeakSanitizer coverage is claimed.

guarantees: List, Search, AddFile and AddDirectory requests use native current-credential checks through the held directory. There is no permission-bit/ACL emulation, original pathname reopen, probe creation, content write, backup intent or privilege change.

Linux directly invokes faccessat2 with AT_EMPTY_PATH|AT_EACCESS, without older libc/kernel fallbacks. Darwin uses faccessat with fixed internal dot and AT_EACCESS. Native prefix/search checks may differ between these families.

Windows opens the exact held directory ID with the requested directory right plus metadata/synchronize rights, reparse/no-recall flags, full sharing, and no backup flag. Fresh identity/provider/kind checks qualify the temporary handle and original directory.

Denials and unavailable errors remain explicit with native diagnostics. A successful check carries request/family/mask/identity, never permission to perform a later operation. Enumeration remains independent.
Native permission-change fixtures restore permissions/ACLs. Darwin ACL denial is enforced despite writable mode bits, and Windows DACL changes are rechecked despite retaining an earlier cursor.
limitations: This is access-check evidence, not a complete operation capability. Names, exact child rights, quotas, capacity, mount state, immutable flags, inheritance, security semantics, providers and concurrent changes need independent planning/execution checks.

POSIX Add requests both map to W_OK|X_OK; they do not separately establish file/directory creation or waive sticky-directory deletion rules. Windows masks include metadata/sync access, so a denial can include those extra requirements.
Linux has no generic provider/locality query and no hydration guarantee is inferred. Known Darwin/Windows provider states block checks; native calls may block and must stay on workers.
Native Windows qualification is ReFS on the V: workstation drive. Other filesystems/drivers may refuse open-by-ID; no path fallback is supplied and no broader native qualification is claimed.
No macOS LeakSanitizer coverage is claimed. WP-01 and WP-02..08 remain incomplete; mutation and operation/execution capability integration are still required.
